summary_1line: Narada recounts Parashurama’s extermination of Kshatriyas, vast sacrifices, and eventual withdrawal, stressing that even the greatest heroes ultimately die.

image_candidates.scene_text: Parashurama stands amid a battlefield piled with fallen chariots, horses, and warriors, raising his blood-stained axe after annihilating the Kshatriyas.
At a grand sacrifice, Parashurama presents the jewel-covered earth and golden elephants as gifts to the sage Kasyapa before a towering golden altar.
Obeying Kasyapa’s command, Parashurama shoots arrows that force the ocean to retreat as he departs toward the distant Mahendra mountain.
